description: Set the voice of one of the team's described presenters, by its id from list_presenters or keep_presenter: woman or man, the person's choice, which a picture does not tell. It replaces any voice set before, and the same call again changes nothing. An id that is none of the team's described presenters, Say It Again's own among them, is refused with invalid_request. The voice is read when a video with this presenter is made, so a video already made keeps its own. Only an Arabic video whose voice is added after filming speaks in this voice; make_video and another_language refuse such a video with refused while its described presenter has no voice. Answers presenter, with its id, name and voice. Free.

presenter.description: The described presenter's id from list_presenters.

voice.description: A woman's voice or a man's voice.

name: set_presenter_voice
title: A presenter's voice
